model.query:
svcUp = from(bucket: "kube_metrics")
  |> range(start: -10m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "service_health" and r._field == "up")
  |> group(columns: ["service"])
current = svcUp |> last() |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "current"})
recent = svcUp |> min() |> keep(columns: ["service", "_value"]) |> rename(columns: {_value: "recent"})
join(tables: {c: current, r: recent}, on: ["service"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ service: r.service, _value: if r.current == 0.0 then 0.0 else if r.recent == 0.0 then 1.0 else 2.0 }))
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _time: now() }))
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "service", "_value"])
